raw.title: build(deps): bump respec from 37.3.0 to 37.3.2
raw.body:
Bumps [respec](https://github.com/speced/respec) from 37.3.0 to 37.3.2.
Release notes

Sourced from respec's releases.

v37.3.2

What's Changed

  • chore(deps-dev): bump highlight.js from 11.11.2 to 11.12.0 by @​dependabot[bot] in speced/respec#5395
  • chore(deps): bump puppeteer from 25.5.0 to 25.7.0 by @​dependabot[bot] in speced/respec#5396
  • chore(deps-dev): bump globals from 17.9.0 to 17.11.0 by @​dependabot[bot] in speced/respec#5397

Full Changelog: https://github.com/speced/respec/compare/v37.3.1...v37.3.2

v37.3.1

Fixes

  • fix(core/data-include): Validate response.ok before injecting data-include content by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5389
  • fix(core/inlines): render self-citation as <cite> with spec title by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5217
  • fix(w3c/headers): always show history link without checking if it exists by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5290
  • fix(w3c/headers): show version URLs as readable IRIs by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5378
  • fix(linter): translate warning to Dutch by @​rien333 in speced/respec#5325
  • fix(w3c/headers): translate some header text to Dutch by @​rien333 in speced/respec#5326
  • fix(core/dfn): ignore definitions inside <del> by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5208
  • fix(a11y): name the modal close button and MDN engine icons for AT by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5206

New Contributors

  • @​rien333 made their first contribution in speced/respec#5325
